DSST examinations

Credit-by-examination options. Five exact exam-form matches are documented for Liberty online undergraduate requirements; coverage for other exams and schools remains DegreeSteps research.

Browse DSST exams

Choose a degree plan to see where specific courses fit.

Study format
Prepare independently and schedule an appointment; current policy includes a 30-day retest interval.
Pricing
Published exam fee: $100 per distinct exam, plus testing-center administration charges. Military funding or reimbursement depends on the student’s own eligibility and program rules.
Assessments
Test-center or remote ProProctor delivery where offered. Public Speaking includes a speech and is not available remotely.
Credit type
Credit examinations with individual recommended credit amounts and levels; the receiving university decides the award.
Transfer and enrollment details

How the credit works

Credit examinations with individual recommended credit amounts and levels; the receiving university decides the award.

Before enrolling

  • Start with your degree plan to see the proposed receiving course or requirement.
  • Review any course-specific enrollment, equipment or assessment steps shown in your plan.
  • University decisions about your own records remain separate from published course matches.
